eidolon_trait_bonus_activations.detail: Each round, the Eidolon takes one turn for every two mech characters hostile to it in the combat, to a maximum of four turns. It regains spent reactions at the start of each of its turns, though 1/round effects only refresh on its first turn each round.
eidolon_trait_bonus_activations.name: Bonus Activations
eidolon_trait_incomprehensible.detail: SCAN (and other abilities that reveal an NPCs statistics) provide no information about the Eidolon or its shards. Instead, characters that SCAN the Eidolon or try to reveal its statistics receive hints about the active layer’s capabilities (listed in the layer profile under “Hints”).
eidolon_trait_incomprehensible.name: Incomprehensible
eidolon_trait_layer_order.detail: Only one of the Eidolon’s layers is active at a time and only the active layer is a valid target that can take damage.
eidolon_trait_layer_order.name: Layer Order
eidolon_trait_memetic_weapons.detail: Eidolons have a new type of weapons: MEMETIC weapons. These weapons ignore engagement and do not affect allied characters, even if they are caught in their area of effect.
eidolon_trait_memetic_weapons.name: Memetic Weapons
eidolon_trait_metamorphosis.detail: When the active layer reaches 0 HP, that layer is destroyed, evaporating from the field. The Eidolon and its shards clear all statuses and conditions, and all other effects targeting them immediately end (including GRAPPLE, etc). The Eidolon remains, occupying the same space and providing obstruction as a blurring, shifting image, but it and all its shards gain IMMUNITY to all damage and effects until the start of its next turn. At the start of that turn, a new layer manifests and any effects specific to that layer begin (including the creation of new shards, etc).
eidolon_trait_metamorphosis.name: Metamorphosis
eidolon_trait_ominous_hovering.detail: The Eidolon and its shards can fly equal to their SPEED and hover, but never willingly move more than 1 space above the ground or any other surface. They never fall; if forced to land, they will always descend safely to the ground.
eidolon_trait_ominous_hovering.name: Ominous Hovering
eidolon_trait_predictable.detail: The Eidolon can take any actions available to an NPC (QUICK TECH, HIDE, etc.) but always performs any special actions available to its current layer first, if possible. Each layer profile presents a suggested order, but these are not mandatory. Unless stated otherwise, shards can only take a standard move.
eidolon_trait_predictable.name: Predictable
el_core_anticausal_thought.name: Anticausal Thought
el_core_pulsing_core.effect: This layer is Size 1/2 and has 1 HP.
el_core_pulsing_core.name: Pulsing Core
el_core.name: Core
el_core.rules: The Eidolon’s core has no shards. Any shards on the field when this layer is revealed are immediately vaporized, destroyed in the blink of an eye. Once the core is destroyed, the Eidolon is defeated.
el_core.shard_detail: The Eidolon’s core has no shards. Any shards on the field when this layer is revealed are immediately vaporized, destroyed in the blink of an eye.
nrfaw_elayer_abyssal_appetite.effect: Each time this weapon is fired, its damage increases by an additional +2, with no maximum. The Eidolon can use APPETITE from its true location or from the location of any of its shards
nrfaw_elayer_abyssal_appetite.name: APPETITE
nrfaw_elayer_abyssal_conjure_shade.actio: The Eidolon creates two new shards in free spaces within line of sight and Range 3.
nrfaw_elayer_abyssal_conjure_shade.name: Conjure Shade
nrfaw_elayer_abyssal.appearance: A voidspace; the accretion disk of a black hole, ringed by dying light; a starfield of incredible depth.
nrfaw_elayer_abyssal.hints: This layer uses its shards as decoys. They are fragile and easily crushed, unlike the real thing
nrfaw_elayer_abyssal.name: Abyssal
nrfaw_elayer_abyssal.rules:
While this layer is active, the Eidolon is Size 1/2, permanently Invisible, and teleports when it moves.
As soon as this layer manifests, pitch black darkness blankets the entire battlefield and Eidolon teleports to a point within line of sight and �8. Hostile characters other than the Eidolon can’t draw line of sight to or target anything further away than Range 2; however, they do share line of sight with allied characters, allowing them to act as spotters for each other.
The precise locations of the Eidolon and its shards are not revealed on the map unless a hostile character moves within Range 2 of them. Characters that are targeted by APPETITE are aware of the cardinal direction the attack came from, but not the precise location.
nrfaw_elayer_abyssal.shard_detail:
New shards are created in free spaces within Range 3 of the Eidolon’s location after appearing and teleporting for the first time.
When it first appears, the Eidolon can redeploy any active shards to any free space within Range 3.
The shards have 1 HP, are INVISIBLE, are destroyed if they fail a save or take heat, and cannot move or take any actions, although the layer can use their positions to fire its APPETITE memetic.
If the Eidolon is successfully hit by an attack or effect, all active shards are immediately destroyed (although it can still create new ones).
nrfaw_elayer_adamant_exhort.name: Exhort
nrfaw_elayer_adamant_exhort.on_hit.detai: The target becomes Shredded. This condition lasts until the layer is destroyed, and cannot be removed in any other way. Characters that are already Shredded take double damage.
nrfaw_elayer_adamant_metallic_shriek.act: Produce a new shard in a free space within Range 5
nrfaw_elayer_adamant.appearance: An infinite metallic lattice; a rigid bulwark of oily darkness; a confusion of needles suspended in space; a loved one, furious.
nrfaw_elayer_adamant.hints: The Eidolon bristles with kinetic energy. Its Armor looks like it can be stripped through repeated attacks, but doing so might be dangerous.
nrfaw_elayer_adamant.name: Adamant
nrfaw_elayer_adamant.rules: While this layer is active, the Eidolon has {10/15/20} Armor. Each time it takes damage, it loses 2 Armor. When the Eidolon’s Armor is reduced by any means, including its own attacks, it releases a Burst 2 explosion of debris around itself, dealing 2 Kinetic Damage to all objects and characters within the affected area.
nrfaw_elayer_adamant.shard_detail:
At the end of the Eidolon’s turn, all shards move up to their Speed toward the nearest hostile character but take no other action or movement.
Whenever the Eidolon loses Armor, each shard produces a Burst 1 explosion of debris around itself, dealing 2 Kinetic Damage to all objects and characters within the affected area.
nrfaw_elayer_agony_test.action_begone.de:
A thin polychromatic beam connects the Eidolon to a character within line of sight, drawn as a line between them. The beam tracks the target with unerring accuracy. The Eidolon can have multiple beams active at the same time.
At the end of the target’s turn, they must succeed on an AGILITY save or take {18/24/30} AP Energy damage, after which this effect ends. On a success, they take half damage.
However, if the beam is interrupted by an obstacle or character, that object/character becomes the beam’s new target until a different object/character passes through the beam. If the beam hits a shard, the shard’s destroyed and the Eidolon shrieks, losing RESISTANCE to all damage until the end of the next round. If an object interrupts the beam, a SIZE 1 section is annihilated regardless of HP, blasted into dust.
nrfaw_elayer_agony_test.name: Begone
nrfaw_elayer_agony_torment.action_tormen: The Eidolon teleports up to 5 spaces to a space in line of sight. The character that damaged it must pass a SYSTEMS save or only have line of sight to adjacent spaces until the end of their next turn.
You can only see adjacent spaces until the end of your next turn.
nrfaw_elayer_agony_torment.name: Torment
nrfaw_elayer_agony.appearance: Polychromatic flashing lights; a shattered, mirrored surface; a thin, robed figure, silent and shivering.
nrfaw_elayer_agony.hints: Using cover or the Eidolon’s own shards will block this layer’s powerful weapon.
nrfaw_elayer_agony.name: Agony
nrfaw_elayer_agony.rules:
While this layer is active, it has Immunity to Slowed and Immobilized, and cannot be Grappled. It teleports when it moves and has Resistance to all damage.
On its turn, the Eidolon teleports 5 spaces then uses BEGONE. It takes no other actions.
nrfaw_elayer_agony.shard_detail: Shards attempt to move as close to hostile characters as possible, then attach to them when adjacent, sharing their space and mirroring their movement. While a character has a shard attached to them, they are SHREDDED, IMPAIRED, and take 2 Energy Damage per shard attached at the start of their turn, but the shards will automatically interrupt the BEGONE weapon. They can remove any number of shards from themselves by succeeding on a HULL check as a quick action, pushing them off into adjacent spaces.
nrfaw_elayer_blurred_dream_logic_chronol: The target must succeed on an Agility save or become Slowed until the end of their next turn. Characters that are already Slowed or Stunned instead take {4/5/6} Energy Damage
nrfaw_elayer_blurred_infinite_blur.actio: A character within line of sight and Range 5 takes 4 AP Energy Damage. As a side effect, they become supercharged with chronal energy. On their next turn, they gain Immunity to Slowed and Stunned, their Speed increases to 10 if it is slower, they can Boost 1/turn as a free action, and they treat the layer as if it isn’t moving rapidly. This lasts until the end of their turn, at which point they are Stunned until the end of their following turn.

On your next turn, you gain Immunity to Slowed and Stunned, your Speed increases to 10 if it is slower, you can Boost 1/turn as a free action, and you treat the Eidolon layer as if it isn’t moving rapidly. This lasts until the end of their your, at which point you are Stunned until the end of your following turn.
nrfaw_elayer_blurred_infinite_blur.name: Infinite Blur
nrfaw_elayer_blurred.appearance: A coherent pocket of rapid movement; a shimmering blindness; a person, rapidly aging but never decaying
nrfaw_elayer_blurred.hints: The Eidolon will be easier to hit if it is Slowed or Immobilized (or if someone else is sped up).
nrfaw_elayer_blurred.name: Blurred
nrfaw_elayer_blurred.rules:
While this layer is active, the Eidolon is moving rapidly. This gives it Evasion 20, Speed 10, Resistance to all damage and Immunity to Grapple, and allows it to treat any critical hits on itself as normal hits.
If the Eidolon is Slowed or Immobilized, the Eidolon stops moving rapidly, ending these effects. This lasts until the end of the next character’s turn.
The Eidolon can take a quick action at the end of each other character’s turn. This is not a reaction. It can only use this special quick action to either Boost or use one of this layer's systems.
nrfaw_elayer_blurred.shard_detail: At the start of the Eidolon’s turn, its shards can move up to 2 spaces in any direction, but they can’t take any other actions. If the Eidolon moves through a space occupied by one of its shards, that shard is destroyed in a Burst 2 explosion. Hostile characters within the affected area take 2 Energy Damage and are Slowed until the start of their next turn.
nrfaw_elayer_canopy_detonate_splinter.ac: At the start of the Eidolon’s turn, one shard of its choice begins to glow with white-hot energy. Unless the shard is destroyed, it explodes at the start of the Eidolon’s next turn. Characters within Burst 2 must pass an AGILITY save or take {5/6/7} Explosive Damage
nrfaw_elayer_canopy_detonate_splinter.ef: At the start of the Eidolon’s turn, one shard of its choice begins to glow with white-hot energy. Unless the shard is destroyed, it explodes at the start of the Eidolon’s next turn. Characters within Burst 2 must pass an AGILITY save or take {5/6/7} Explosive Damage
nrfaw_elayer_canopy_empower_splinter.act: One shard of the Eidolon's choice gains OVERSHIELD {4/5/6} and +1 Accuracy on all attacks, and deals +5 damage with SPLINTERING TENDRILS
This shard gains +1 Accuracy on all attacks and deals +5 damage with SPLINTERING TENDRILS.
nrfaw_elayer_canopy_overgrowth.action_ov: The Eidolon creates 1d3 shards in free spaces within Range 8.
nrfaw_elayer_canopy_overgrowth.name: Overgrowth
nrfaw_elayer_Canopy.appearance: A wall of foliage; the abaxial surface of a leaf, crossed by veins of blood; a dirty, scratched crystalline plane, overgrown with moss.
nrfaw_elayer_Canopy.hints: This layer seems to be harmed by the loss of its shards.
nrfaw_elayer_Canopy.name: Canopy
nrfaw_elayer_Canopy.rules: While this layer is active, the Eidolon can’t move and has Immunity to all damage and effects other than damage dealt by its shards’ LINKED trait
nrfaw_elayer_Canopy.shard_detail: Shards are destroyed if they overheat. When this layer is destroyed, all shards are destroyed along with it.
nrfaw_elayer_enceladian_bonechill.action: The Eidolon batters a Blast 2 area within line of sight and Range 15 with ice. Hostile characters within the affected area must succeed on a HULL save or take 3 Kinetic Damage and clear 4 Heat. A swirling blizzard covers the affected area, making it difficult terrain and providing soft cover until this layer is destroyed. The Eidolon ignores this cover.
nrfaw_elayer_enceladian_bonechill.name: Bonechill
nrfaw_elayer_enceladian_creeping_rime.ef: Characters take {2/3/4} Energy Damage if they are not in the DANGER ZONE at the start of their turn. This damage cannot be prevented or reduced in any way. Characters that are IMMOBILIZED take double damage. Characters within this aura with 0 Heat at the end of the round become IMMOBILIZED by a thick layer of frost. As a quick action, a character can break free (or break an adjacent character free) by succeeding on a HULL check, ending this effect.
nrfaw_elayer_enceladian_ice_spear.name: Ice Spear
nrfaw_elayer_enceladian_ice_spear.on_hit: This weapon does double damage against IMMOBILIZED targets.
nrfaw_elayer_enceladian_remove_functiona: The Eidolon projects a Line 30 beam of energy in any direction. Hostile characters in the affected area must succeed on an AGILITY save or take {8/10/12} Energy Damage. On a success, or if they are in cover, they take half damage.
nrfaw_elayer_enceladian.appearance: Pure white sea ice from which deep cracks sound; a gray haze through which blue light can be seen; a pane of steaming black glass, marbled with frost
nrfaw_elayer_enceladian.hints: Staying hot will allow you avoid the worst of this layer’s effects.
nrfaw_elayer_enceladian.name: Enceladian
nrfaw_elayer_enceladian.rules: While this layer is active, the Eidolon has 2 Armor and Resistance to all damage from characters not in the Danger Zone.
nrfaw_elayer_enceladian.shard_detail: All shards cannot move and can only attack with LESSER ICE SPEAR.
nrfaw_elayer_fundamental_core_assumption: Up to three characters within line of sight and Range 10 must succeed on Hull saves or take {4/5/7} Kinetic Damage and be knocked back 3 spaces
nrfaw_elayer_fundamental_reunite.action_: Two characters within line of sight and Range 15 are pushed as far as possible in a straight line toward each other. Colliding with a shard or obstacle causes them to stop, otherwise they slam into each other and must each succeed on a HULL save. On a failure, they take Kinetic Damage equal to the number of spaces between them when this action was taken (up to a maximum of {10/14/18} Kinetic Damage) and are knocked Prone. On a success, they take half damage and avoid being knocked Prone.
nrfaw_elayer_fundamental_reunite.name: Reunite
nrfaw_elayer_fundamental.appearance: A white, polished marble statue; a bruised and battered person dripping with corrosive oils; your father or mentor, terrified and weeping.
nrfaw_elayer_fundamental.hints: To have any chance of harming this layer, its shards must be reunited by being pushed back together. It would be wise to stay close together
nrfaw_elayer_fundamental.name: Fundamental
nrfaw_elayer_fundamental.rules:
While this layer is active, the Eidolon has Immunity to all damage and effects.
When this layer manifests, teleport all shards to nonadjacent free spaces within Range 5 of the Eidolon. The moment all shards are formed into one contiguous shape, the Eidolon is Stunned until the end of its next turn. Additionally, it permanently loses the Immunity granted by this layer.
nrfaw_elayer_fundamental.shard_detail:
These shards cannot move or take actions on their own. They have Immunity to all damage and effects except those specified below.
The shards can be pushed up to 3 spaces in a straight line in any direction as a quick action. Hitting them with ranged or melee attacks also pushes them 1 space in a direction of the attacker’s choice. Knockback and Grapple can also be used to move them.
When this layer is destroyed, all shards on the battlefield melt into inert puddles of water
nrfaw_elayer_gaze_searing_reality.effect: Characters take 2 Energy Damage and 2 Heat if they are not in hard cover or a zone that grants soft cover at the start of their turn.
nrfaw_elayer_gaze_searing_reality.name: Searing Reality
nrfaw_elayer_gaze_strip_matter.active_ef: At the start of every round, the Eidolon causes one shard to explode into a Burst 1 VOID ZONE of disintegrating space. Characters that either enter this space for the first time in a round or start their turn there take 3 Energy Damage, which cannot be reduced in any way. VOID ZONES do not block movement or line of sight, or provide cover, and objects, DRONES, and other DEPLOYABLES are instantly destroyed if they move or are placed within one. They last until the layer is destroyed.
nrfaw_elayer_gaze_strip_matter.effect: At the start of every round, the Eidolon causes one shard to explode into a Burst 1 VOID ZONE of disintegrating space. Characters that either enter this space for the first time in a round or start their turn there take 3 Energy Damage, which cannot be reduced in any way. VOID ZONES do not block movement or line of sight, or provide cover, and objects, DRONES, and other DEPLOYABLES are instantly destroyed if they move or are placed within one. They last until the layer is destroyed.
nrfaw_elayer_gaze_strip_matter.name: Strip Matter
nrfaw_elayer_gaze.appearance: A single eye, unblinking; a being made from steady light; your mother or an analogous figure.
nrfaw_elayer_gaze.hints: You can hide behind the shards or use them for cover, but it might be necessary to expose yourself to this layer’s effects to damage it.
nrfaw_elayer_gaze.name: Gaze
nrfaw_elayer_gaze.rules: While this layer is active, the Eidolon is permanently Immobilized and cannot move or be moved, even by external effects. It has Resistance to all damage from characters not standing in a Void Zone.
nrfaw_elayer_gaze.shard_detail: Shards must be placed within Range 8 of the Eidolon but not within 3 spaces of each other. They cannot move or take actions, and provide hard cover for all characters, allied and hostile
nrfaw_elayer_labyrinthine_incorrect.acti: 1-2 characters within SENSORS, or a character that lost a contested check take {3/4/5} Heat and are knocked back 4 spaces in a direction of the Eidolon’s choice.
nrfaw_elayer_labyrinthine_incorrect.name: Incorrect
nrfaw_elayer_labyrinthine_superheated_lo: At the start of each round, all hostile characters take 1 Heat. This increases by 2 Heat each round (3 Heat in the second round, then 5 Heat, 7 Heat, etc.) up to 10 Heat.
nrfaw_elayer_labyrinthine_test.action_te: A character within SENSORS must play a game of rock, paper, scissors with the GM. If this isn’t possible, the GM and the player each roll 1d6 and the highest roll wins (rerolling on ties). If the character wins, they can make a guess about the Eidolon’s labyrinth (see RULES). If they lose, they become STUNNED until another character moves adjacent to them and ends this effect as a quick action.
nrfaw_elayer_labyrinthine_test.name: Test
nrfaw_elayer_labyrinthine.appearance: Perfect geometry, folding recursive in on itself; crisp paper, features defined by a single folded crease; a painted wooden door, visible from only one side.
nrfaw_elayer_labyrinthine.hints: The Eidolon has an interface of some sorts that looks like someone could interact with it – a door, a console, a game board, or something similar.
nrfaw_elayer_labyrinthine.name: Labyrinthine
nrfaw_elayer_labyrinthine.rules:
While this layer is active, the Eidolon cannot move, has Immunity to all damage and effects, and has Systems {+2/+4/+6}.
When this layer appears, draw a 3x3 grid – the labyrinth – on a piece of paper and sequentially mark the rows A/B/C and the columns 1/2/3. Secretly note down the coordinates of two of the nine spaces (i.e., A1, B3, etc.). As a quick action, characters adjacent to the layer or one of its shards can make two guesses about which spaces in the labyrinth contain a mark. Tell them if they are correct or not. When a character guesses both marks correctly in the same attempt, the layer is destroyed. For each incorrect guess, the Eidolon uses INCORRECT against them as a reaction, ignoring the 1/turn limit.
Each target (i.e., the Eidolon or one of its shards) can only be used to guess once per round.
nrfaw_elayer_labyrinthine.shard_detail: On their turn, the shards move as far away from hostile characters as possible while remaining within Range 8 of the Eidolon. They can take no other actions.
nrfaw_elayer_marine_drag_under.action_dr: The Eidolon deals 4 AP Kinetic damage to any characters that it currently has Grappled and then Grapples another adjacent character. It can have any number of characters Grappled at one time and can move and take reactions normally while doing so, no matter how many characters it has Grappled.
nrfaw_elayer_marine_drag_under.name: Drag Under
nrfaw_elayer_marine_spit_out.action_spit: The Eidolon violently ejects a Grappled character from its grasp, ending the Grapple and knocking them 5 spaces back. If the target collides with a shard, it explodes. The shard is destroyed and the target must succeed on a Hull save or take {8/10/12} Kinetic Damage and become Immobilized until the end of their next turn. On a success, they take half damage and there are no other effects.
nrfaw_elayer_marine_spit_out.name: Spit Out
nrfaw_elayer_marine_swallow.name: Swallow
nrfaw_elayer_marine_swallow.on_hit.detai: The target must succeed on an Agility save or be pulled 5 spaces directly toward the Eidolon, or as far as possible.
nrfaw_elayer_marine.appearance: A deep depth lit from even deeper space; the white of an endless crashing wave; a water-bloated body, unidentifiable
nrfaw_elayer_marine.hints: Superheating this layer will easily destroy it.
nrfaw_elayer_marine.name: Marine
nrfaw_elayer_marine.rules:
While this layer is active, the Eidolon is Size 3 and has E-Defense 5, Hull +6, and Resistance to all damage. Any melee weapon that successfully damages it has a 50% chance of becoming stuck, rendering it unusable. While adjacent to the Eidolon, the attacker can retrieve their weapon by winning a contested Hull check as a quick action. Embedded weapons fall to the ground and can be retrieved as a free action from any adjacent space upon the layer’s destruction.
If the Eidolon overheats, it permanently loses Resistance to all damage and becomes Slowed.
nrfaw_elayer_marine.shard_detail: Shards can be placed within Range 8 of the Eidolon. All shards cannot move or take any actions, and each produces a Burst 2 area of difficult terrain around itself in the form of a watery expanse of shifting gravity.
nrfaw_elayer_punishment_discipline.effec: Hostile characters beyond Range 8 are EXPOSED. They can only clear this condition by moving within Range 8 of the Eidolon.
nrfaw_elayer_punishment_discipline.name: Discipline
nrfaw_elayer_punishment_release.effect: This weapon can attack two targets within line of sight at a time. It deals +3 Kinetic Damage to IMMOBILIZED characters
nrfaw_elayer_punishment_release.name: Release
nrfaw_elayer_punishment_test.action_scat: All hostile characters within line of sight and Range 15 take 2 Kinetic Damage and are knocked back 2 spaces in a direction of the Eidolon’s choice.
nrfaw_elayer_punishment_test.name: Scattering Lash
nrfaw_elayer_punishment.appearance: Tangled ropes, tightening without end; a whirlwind of chains; a rusted steel door, visible only from one side; a stone pillar, splattered with blood, behind which a figure peers out at you.
nrfaw_elayer_punishment.hints: Immobilized allies must be freed and must move close to the layer or take heavy damage
nrfaw_elayer_punishment.name: Punishment
nrfaw_elayer_punishment.rules:
While this layer is active, the Eidolon has 2 Armor, 2 Speed, and Immunity to all damage and effects from Immobilized characters.
At the start of each round, all hostile characters except one (chosen by the Eidolon) become Immobilized. Characters that were already Immobilized clear the condition. Characters Immobilized by this effect can only clear the condition if a non-Immobilized character moves next to them.
Immobilized characters cannot be knocked back by the Eidolon.
nrfaw_elayer_punishment.shard_detail: The shards cannot move. As a free action, a character can destroy an adjacent shard, taking 1 Explosive damage and either taking BOOST immediately as a free action or clearing IMMOBILIZED.
nrfaw_elayer_purity_hcy.name: How Could You?
nrfaw_elayer_purity_hcy.on_hit.detail: Targets are IMPAIRED until the end of their next turn.
nrfaw_elayer_purity_shame.effect: When a character deals damage to a shard, the attacker takes 2 Energy Damage. This damage cannot be prevented or reduced in any way.
nrfaw_elayer_purity_shame.name: Shame
nrfaw_elayer_purity_test.action_soft_rin: The Eidolon moves spaces equal to its SPEED, then deals 1 Energy Damage in a Burst 2 area. Each time it takes this action in a combat, this damage increases by +2 Energy Damage, with no upper limit.
nrfaw_elayer_purity_test.name: Soft Ringing
nrfaw_elayer_purity.appearance: A blank space from within which a single bell rings; a white void from which soft muttering issues; a perfectly clear prism.
nrfaw_elayer_purity.hints: This layer seems to regenerate continuously. A burst of damage will be needed to destroy it, but destroying its shards will weaken it.
nrfaw_elayer_purity.name: Purity
nrfaw_elayer_purity.rules: While this layer is active, the Eidolon has 1 HP; however, when it first appears, and at the start of each of its turns, it gains Overshield {10/15/20} and an additional Overshield +5 for each shard within Range 10.
nrfaw_elayer_purity.shard_detail:
The shards have SPEED 2 and the only action they take is to move as far away from hostile characters as far as possible while remaining within Range 10 of the layer. They attempt to move to within that range if they are further away.
As noted above, whenever the Eidolon gains OVERSHIELD, it gains an additional OVERSHIELD +5 for each shard within Range 10.
nrfaw_elayer_rancorous_disgust.effect: This weapon can attack two targets within line of sight at a time. The damage it deals cannot reduce characters past 1 HP.
nrfaw_elayer_rancorous_disgust.name: Disgust
Hostile characters within Range 5 must pass a HULL test or become EXPOSED and SHREDDED until they STABILIZE. Objects, DRONES, and DEPLOYABLES within Range 5 take 30 AP Explosive Damage.
nrfaw_elayer_rancorous_fury.name: Fury
nrfaw_elayer_rancorous_grief.action_grie: Any characters beyond Range 5 must succeed on an ENGINEERING test or take 5 Heat and become JAMMED and SLOWED until they STABILIZE.
nrfaw_elayer_rancorous_grief.name: Grief
nrfaw_elayer_rancorous.appearance: A greasy smear of dark smoke; a tear through which thousands of reaching hands attempt to grab you; your lover or object of affection, cruel.
nrfaw_elayer_rancorous.hints: Survive. This layer only lasts a very short time, so taking purely defensive actions would be beneficial.
nrfaw_elayer_rancorous.name: Rancorous
nrfaw_elayer_rancorous.rules:
While this layer is active, the Eidolon has Immunity to all damage and effects. If it is attacked, it screams loudly in fear and anger.
Regardless of how many turns the Eidolon takes, it only acts during its final turn in a round. It spends its other turns pulsing angrily in the same place. On its last turn in the round, it:
  1. moves toward the closest character
  2. attacks with DISGUST
  3. activates FURY and then GRIEF, ignoring action limits
  4. burns itself up in white-hot fire, destroying itself.
nrfaw_elayer_rancorous.shard_detail: Existing shards scream continuously until the layer is destroyed but take no other action.
nrfaw_elayer_reflective_envy.action_envy: All characters able to see the Eidolon must make a SYSTEMS save. On a failure, they must use their standard move to move as close to the Eidolon or any of its shards as possible and spend as many remaining actions as possible attacking the Eidolon or its shards.
nrfaw_elayer_reflective_envy.name: Envy
nrfaw_elayer_reflective_refract.action_r: The Eidolon creates a new shard for every hostile character within Range 3 of its location. These shards are warped images of those characters’ pilots and appear adjacent to them.
nrfaw_elayer_reflective_refract.name: Refract
nrfaw_elayer_reflective_truth_spear.effe: If the line of this attack intersects with a shard, that shard projects the attack by an additional Line 5 in a direction of the Eidolon’s choice, increasing its area. This effect repeats if the extended LINE intersects with a new shard.
nrfaw_elayer_reflective_truth_spear.name: Truth Spear
nrfaw_elayer_reflective.appearance: A sheet of perfectly reflective glass; a liquid tear in space; you, as you want to be; you, as you fear yourself to be; you, as you could have been.
nrfaw_elayer_reflective.hints: Dealing energy damage or burn to this layer seems like a poor idea
nrfaw_elayer_reflective.name: Reflective
nrfaw_elayer_reflective.rules:
While this layer is active, any attack that deals any amount of energy damage or burn to the Eidolon has a 50% chance to be redirected to the character closest to the NHP, potentially even the attacker. This check is made after the attack roll and all bonuses are applied, but before damage is dealt.
If an attack is reflected, it automatically misses the Eidolon; instead, if the result of the attack roll was high enough to hit the new target, it does so.
If multiple characters (including the Eidolon’s shards) are the same distance from the Eidolon, the GM chooses who is targeted by the redirected attack.
nrfaw_elayer_reflective.shard_detail: The shards redirect energy damage and burn like the Eidolon. They move and use the Lesser Truth Spear weapon.
nrfaw_elayer_sacrificial_rivalry.action_: The Eidolon links two characters within line of sight and Range 10 together. Affected characters take 5 Energy damage and become STUNNED at the end of their next turn until the end of their following turn unless they make an attack roll against the linked character or force that character to make a save. Linked characters are aware of this effect.
nrfaw_elayer_sacrificial_rivalry.name: Rivalry
nrfaw_elayer_sacrificial_share_pain.acti:
The Eidolon chooses a character within line of sight and Range 10, highlighting itself and its target in pulsing bright red light. That character gains RESISTANCE to all damage and when they take damage, the Eidolon also takes an amount of damage equivalent to the full amount of damage that would have been dealt before any reductions (e.g., ARMOR and RESISTANCE).
The Eidolon must choose a new target for this effect at the start of each of its turns.
nrfaw_elayer_sacrificial_share_pain.name: Share Pain
nrfaw_elayer_sacrificial.appearance: A massive ruby; a dull basalt megalith; an open iron gate revealing a carpeted hallway that disappears into darkness.
nrfaw_elayer_sacrificial.hints: One character is linked to the Eidolon at a time. They must take damage in order to hurt this layer.
nrfaw_elayer_sacrificial.name: Sacrificial
nrfaw_elayer_sacrificial.rules: While this layer is active, the Eidolon has Immunity to all damage except any dealt by SHARE PAIN.
nrfaw_elayer_sacrificial.shard_detail: The shards attempt to move as close to the character marked by the Eidolon’s SHARE PAIN trait as possible and then attack them.
nrfaw_elayer_screaming_paralyzing_fear.a: One hostile character within Range 5 must succeed on a SYSTEMS save or take {4/5/6} Energy damage and immediately use its reaction this turn to move a distance equal to its SPEED as far away from the layer as possible.
nrfaw_elayer_screaming.appearance: A dark crystal, smoking shapes rippling beneath its surface; a person, trapped behind fogged glass; a wall of skin, something moving beneath its surface.
nrfaw_elayer_screaming.hints: This layer’s screams don’t seem to affect those who draw closer to it.
nrfaw_elayer_screaming.name: Screaming
nrfaw_elayer_screaming.rules:
While this layer is active, the Eidolon has Speed 2.
It ceaselessly screams in a distorted human voice. At the start of each round, all characters fully outside of Range 3 but within Range 50 of the Eidolon take 2 AP Energy Damage. This increases by an additional +2 Energy Damage each round, with no maximum.
nrfaw_elayer_screaming.shard_detail: The shards move as close as possible to the nearest hostile character and then attack them.
nrfaw_elayer_siege_kinetic_energy.action:
This action can only be taken if the Eidolon used POTENTIAL ENERGY on its previous turn.
The Eidolon makes two movements equal to its SPEED toward the character it targeted with POTENTIAL ENERGY, freely passing through characters and objects other than shards.
Hostile characters in its path must succeed on an AGILITY save or take {8/10/12} Kinetic Damage and be knocked PRONE. On a success, they take half damage and are not knocked PRONE. Either way, the Eidolon pushes them out of its path by the most direct route possible. Each character can only be hit by this action once each time it’s used, even if they overlap.
Objects are hit by this action automatically. If the Eidolon hits one of its own shards, it immediately stops moving and is knocked PRONE, ending its turn.
nrfaw_elayer_siege_kinetic_energy.name: Kinetic Energy
nrfaw_elayer_siege_potential_energy.acti: The Eidolon remains in place, building energy. It targets the closest hostile character. All characters are aware of this effect.
nrfaw_elayer_siege_potential_energy.name: Potential Energy
nrfaw_elayer_siege.appearance: A block of dull metal; an enormous wheel; darkness, lit by a distant flickering light; a cloud of buzzing insects.
nrfaw_elayer_siege.hints: This layer builds up energy for some reason. You can stop it by making it crash into something.
nrfaw_elayer_siege.name: Siege
nrfaw_elayer_siege.rules:
While this layer is active, the Eidolon has Speed 6 and 2 Armor, and deals triple damage to objects. It has Resistance to all damage unless it is Prone.
The Eidolon is immune to the Slowed and Immobilized conditions and cannot be knocked Prone except by its own shards.
The Eidolon can only move in straight lines.
nrfaw_elayer_siege.shard_detail: The shards move toward as many separate hostile characters as possible and then use BINDING FORCE.
nrfaw_elayer_stable_ordering_beam.effect: This weapon can attack two targets at a time, dealing damage of the type and amount to which the Eidolon is attuned.
nrfaw_elayer_stable_ordering_beam.name: Ordering Beam
nrfaw_elayer_stable_reorder.action_reord: The Eidolon restructures the matter of a character within Range 6, turning parts of them into glossy marble. They take 2 damage of the type to which the Eidolon is attuned, clear all conditions, and then gain OVERSHIELD 2. This damage cannot be reduced or prevented in any way. Each time it takes this action in a scene, the damage dealt and OVERSHIELD gained both increase by +2, with no upper limit.
nrfaw_elayer_stable_reorder.name: Reorder
nrfaw_elayer_stable.appearance: A deep blue planar prism; a rectangular marble column; a statue carved from granite.
nrfaw_elayer_stable.hints: This layer seems to like consistency. Hitting it with a heavy weapon first might be to your benefit.
nrfaw_elayer_stable.name: Stable
nrfaw_elayer_stable.rules:
While this layer is active, the Eidolon has {45/55/65} HP.
The Eidolon can only have one condition at a time and it immediately clears any existing condition as soon as it gains a new one. For example, if a Slowed Eidolon is Grappled, it becomes Immobilized as a result and immediately clears Slowed.
Additionally, the first time the Eidolon takes damage in a round, it attunes to that damage. For the rest of the round, it:
  • gains Immunity to all other damage types
  • deals only damage of that type
  • akes and deals that amount of damage each time it takes damage
nrfaw_elayer_stable.shard_detail: The shards move and attack normally.
nrfaw_elayer_synchronous_horrible_realiz: This weapon doesn’t suffer from engagement penalties. It only deals 1 Explosive Damage to characters other than the synced character.
The target becomes SLOWED until the end of their next turn.
nrfaw_elayer_synchronous_sympathetic_hea: The synced character and the Eidolon both gain OVERSHIELD 4. The Eidolon must take this action if possible
nrfaw_elayer_synchronous.appearance: A mirror image of this same space, distorted in a pane of glass; a mirror in which you see your reflection from behind; a mirror in which you can see nothing.
nrfaw_elayer_synchronous.hints: Only the person synced to the layer seems to be effective against it.
nrfaw_elayer_synchronous.name: Synchronous
nrfaw_elayer_synchronous.rules:
While this layer is active, the Eidolon has Resistance to all damage from other characters and Immunity to all other conditions and effects. The synced character (see below) ignores this restriction.
At the start of its turn, the Eidolon syncs with the closest hostile character. Its attacks and effects can only target the synced character. It attempts to move as close to them as possible.
If a character is synced for two of their consecutive turns, they become Exposed at the start of their turn. They can only clear this condition if a new character becomes synced or the Eidolon is destroyed.
nrfaw_elayer_synchronous.shard_detail: The shards attempt to move as close to the synced character as possible. They can take standard moves but no other actions. The synced character takes +1 Difficulty on all attacks, checks, and saves for every shard within Range 3.
nrfaw_elayer_tempest_batter_and_toss.act: A character within line of sight and Range 10 must succeed on a HULL save or be pushed 6 spaces in a direction of the Eidolon’s choice. On a success, they are only pushed 3 spaces.
nrfaw_elayer_tempest_feedback.active_eff: Eidolon loses RESISTANCE to all damage until end of round
nrfaw_elayer_tempest_feedback.effect: If the Eidolon starts or ends its turn adjacent to two or more hostile characters, it disrupts its own shielding, losing RESISTANCE to all damage until the end of the current round.
nrfaw_elayer_tempest_feedback.name: Feedback
nrfaw_elayer_tempest_photon_diadem.actio: A character within line of sight and Range 10 must succeed on an AGILITY save or take {6/8/10} Energy Damage. Either way, this effect repeats against another character within Range 3 of the first. This effect continues to chain from one character to another as long as there are valid targets in range, but each character can only be affected once per use.
nrfaw_elayer_tempest_photon_diadem.name: Photon Diadem
nrfaw_elayer_tempest.appearance: A roiling storm cloud, rippling with lightning; a purple-white crystal; a lone figure, dripping steaming water.
nrfaw_elayer_tempest.hints: Bunching up against this layer might be a terrible idea, but overloading its shields with proximity might also be the only way to damage it.
nrfaw_elayer_tempest.name: Tempest
nrfaw_elayer_tempest.rules:
While this layer is active, the Eidolon has Speed 3, Immunity to Immobilized, and Resistance to all damage.
Hostile characters that start their turn adjacent to another character or object take {2/3/4} AP Energy Damage.
nrfaw_elayer_tempest.shard_detail: The shards can move and BOOST but take no other actions. They do, however, count as characters for the purpose of PHOTON DIADEM and this layer’s rules, although they take no damage from the layer.
nrfaw_shard_abyssal_override.effect: All shards have 1 HP, HEAT CAP 1, and SPEED 0.
nrfaw_shard_abyssal_override.name: Shard Stat Override
nrfaw_shard_canopy_linked.effect: When a shard is destroyed, the Eidolon takes 2 damage that can’t be reduced or ignored in any way.
nrfaw_shard_canopy_linked.name: Linked
nrfaw_shard_canopy_override.effect: All shards have 1 HP, HEAT CAP 1, and SPEED 4.
nrfaw_shard_canopy_override.name: Shard Stat Override
This weapon can attack two targets within line of sight at a time. It deals +3 Kinetic Damage to IMMOBILIZED characters.
This weapon does double damage against IMMOBILIZED targets.
nrfaw_shard_sacrificial_agony_spine.name: Agony Spine
nrfaw_shard_screaming_keening_wail.name: Keening Wail
nrfaw_shard_siege_binding_force.action_b: An adjacent hostile character must succeed on a HULL save or become IMMOBILIZED and unable to draw line of sight further than adjacent spaces. This lasts until the shard is destroyed or the shard and its target cease to be adjacent. The shard can take no other actions or movement while this effect is active.
You can only see adjacent spaces while immobilized by BINDING FORCE.
nrfaw_shard_siege_binding_force.name: Binding Force
nrfaw_shard_stable_petrifying_beam.effec: This weapon deals damage of the type to which the Eidolon is attuned.
nrfaw_shard_stable_petrifying_beam.name: Petrifying Beam
nrfaw-npc_npcc_avenger.flavor: Avenger-class mechs are typically piloted by zealots, career warriors, and people from cultures that place significant value on praetorian or warrior castes. In battle, these pilots act as force multipliers and squad leaders, but they tend to be more notable as individuals than for their machines. Avenger pilots have tight bonds to their allies – strong enough that the intense emotions of battle, loss, and struggle can push them to incredible feats of heroism when the tide turns in their enemies’ favor.
nrfaw-npc_npcc_avenger.name: Avenger
nrfaw-npc_npcc_avenger.tactics: While not particularly dangerous to begin with, Avengers become much more threatening when their allies start falling around them. Place them near other high-priority targets to take advantage of their REVENGE ability, forcing characters to choose between taking them out first or suffering more for destroying their allies.
nrfaw-npc_npcc_avenger.terse: Avengers are strikers that become more dangerous as their allies fall.
nrfaw-npc_npcc_lurker.flavor: Lurker-class foes are rare but terrifying sights on the battlefield. Usually utilizing greywash-analog nanite clouds and matter compressors, they move from swarm to swarm, lashing out with nanite whips and using their swarms to deflect blows as easily as water.
nrfaw-npc_npcc_lurker.name: Lurker
nrfaw-npc_npcc_lurker.tactics: Lurkers rely on their Shroud Zones for protection and mobility. Deploy Shroud Zones to create safe positions, then use Umbral Shift to teleport between them. Stay within Shroud Zones to benefit from Invisibility and Resistance. Force engagements into Shroud Zones to Shred and Impair enemies. The Lurker is fragile outside its zones, so PCs who can disperse them with tech attacks or smart weapons can neutralize its defenses.
nrfaw-npc_npcc_lurker.terse: Lurkers are elusive strikers that can use their swarms to deflect attacks and strike back with deadly whips.
nrfaw-npc_npcc_spite.flavor: The Spite is an aggressive tech defender chassis commonly used by HORUS techno cults, pirates, and insurgent factions. By using a reactor-override liturgicode, these mechs are able to pry a mech’s reactor cores open and keep them that way, spiking them with feedback each time a weapon is fired. Unaware or reckless pilots taking the field against an experienced Spite pilot will often find themselves cooking themselves to death.
nrfaw-npc_npcc_spite.name: Spite
nrfaw-npc_npcc_spite.tactics: The Spite punishes characters who rely on heat management or careful heat generation to maximize their damage output. Use IMPRISON to lock down dangerous damage-dealers and ENTHRONE it somewhere it can guard its allies, but be careful – it’s relatively immobile and can’t do much on its own.
nrfaw-npc_npcc_spite.terse: Spites are tech defenders that can punish characters who rely on heat management to maximize their damage output.
nrfaw-npc_npcc_strider.flavor: Striders are piloted by scouts, lone wolves, and mavericks - usually the kind of pilots who are accustomed to spending a lot of time behind enemy lines. The massive amount of gear these elite pilots bring with them gives them the ability to adapt to almost any circumstance.
nrfaw-npc_npcc_strider.name: Strider
nrfaw-npc_npcc_strider.tactics: The Strider is very flexible, but only effective at certain range bands. Use its abilities to reposition it so that it can make the most use out of its various kits. Players will find that moving around is a valuable strategy against the Strider, as being too close or too far for it to attack effectively can render it ineffective.
nrfaw-npc_npcc_strider.terse: Striders are flexible artillery that can adapt to many situations, but they need to be in the right range band to be effective.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_assault_armor_avenger.act: The Avenger has Resistance to all damage originating within Range 3.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_assault_armor_avenger.eff: The Avenger has RESISTANCE to all damage originating within Range 3.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_carceri_spite.action_carc: The Spite uses Imprison on all characters of its choice within line of sight and Sensors.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_carceri_spite.effect: The Spite uses IMPRISON on all characters of its choice within line of sight and SENSORS.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_carceri_spite.name: Carceri
nrfaw-npc_npcf_consume_shroud_lurker.act: The Lurker consumes a Shroud Zone they are inside or adjacent to, clearing all conditions, gaining Overshield {4/6/8}, and then moving spaces equal to their Speed. Cannot consume a Shroud Zone created in the same round.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_consume_shroud_lurker.eff: The Lurker consumes a SHROUD ZONE they are inside or adjacent to, clearing all conditions, gaining OVERSHIELD {4/6/8}, and then moving spaces equal to their SPEED. They cannot consume a SHROUD ZONE they created in the same round.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_cqb_training_strider.acti: The Strider has Immunity to Slowed and cannot be Grappled.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_cqb_training_strider.effe: The Strider has IMMUNITY to SLOWED and cannot be GRAPPLED.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_cqb_training_strider.name: CQB Training
nrfaw-npc_npcf_crush_targeting_spite.act: The Spite chooses a character within Sensors and line of sight: they gain +3 Difficulty to attack any character other than the Spite until the start of the Spite's next turn.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_crush_targeting_spite.eff: The Spite chooses a character within SENSORS and line of sight: they gain +3 Difficulty to attack any character other than the Spite until the start of the Spite’s next turn.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_deadly_avenger.active_eff: The Avenger deals +1d6 Kinetic on critical hits.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_deadly_avenger.effect: The Avenger deals +1d6 Kinetic on critical hits.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_deadly_avenger.name: Deadly
nrfaw-npc_npcf_defensive_shroud_lurker.a: The Lurker creates a Shroud Zone centered on its location, even if it already has three active.
The Lurker takes damage or heat.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_defensive_shroud_lurker.e: It creates a SHROUD ZONE centered on its location, even if it already has three active.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_defensive_shroud_lurker.t: The Lurker takes damage or heat.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_devouring_shard_lurker.ac: While inside a Shroud Zone, the Lurker spews a Cone 3 torrent of razor sharp nanites. Characters within the affected area must pass an Engineering save or take {4/5/6} Energy AP. On a success, they take half damage.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_devouring_shard_lurker.ef: While inside a SHROUD ZONE, the Lurker can also spew out a Cone 3 torrent of razor sharp nanites as a quick action. Characters within the affected area must pass an ENGINEERING save or take {4/5/6} Energy AP. On a success, they take half damage.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_empower_shroud_lurker.act: The Lurker expands a Shroud Zone they currently occupy to Blast 2. This can cause it to envelop other characters. It now takes two successful attacks to disperse the effect.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_empower_shroud_lurker.eff: The Lurker expands a SHROUD ZONE they currently occupy to Blast 2. This can cause it to envelop other characters. In addition, it now takes two successful attacks to disperse the effect.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_endless_revenge_avenger.a: Revenge can be triggered any number of times per scene. After the first time, it doesn't grant additional damage increases but instead grants +{4/5/6} Overshield, which increases rather than replaces previous Overshield.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_endless_revenge_avenger.e: REVENGE can be triggered any number of times per scene, but after the first time, it doesn’t grant additional damage increases. Instead it grants +{4/5/6} OVERSHIELD . This doesn’t replace any previous OVERSHIELD, but instead increases it by the same amount.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_enthrone_spite.action_ent: The Spite becomes Immobilized and activates a crackling defensive shield. While this shield is active, any characters that make ranged or melee attacks against the Spite or its adjacent allies take 3/4/5 Energy AP before the attack roll is made. This effect lasts until the end of the Spite's next turn, or if it ends this effect as a quick action.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_enthrone_spite.effect: The Spite becomes IMMOBILIZED and activates a crackling defensive shield. While this shield is active, any characters that make ranged or melee attacks against the Spite or its adjacent allies take {3/4/5} Energy AP before the attack roll is made. This effect lasts until the end of the Spite’s next turn, or if it ends this effect as a quick action.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_enthrone_spite.name: Enthrone

nrfaw-npc_npcf_entrenched_spite.name: Entrenched
nrfaw-npc_npcf_erupting_shrapnel_avenger: When the Avenger's attack damages another character, they may force that character to succeed on an Engineering save or be covered in explosive shrapnel until the end of their next turn. Until then, they take {3/4/5} Explosive AP damage each time they make a melee or ranged attack, after the attack roll is made. Affected characters are aware of this effect.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_feedback_shield_spite.act: The Spite chooses an allied character within line of sight and Range 5. Any character that successfully damages that character immediately becomes Jammed until the end of their next turn. This effect lasts until triggered, or for the rest of the scene.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_feedback_shield_spite.eff: The Spite chooses an allied character within line of sight and Range 5. Any character that successfully damages that character immediately becomes JAMMED until the end of their next turn. This effect lasts until triggered, or for the rest of the scene.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_guardian_spite.active_eff: Adjacent allied characters can use the Spite for hard cover.

nrfaw-npc_npcf_imprison_spite.action_imp: The Spite chooses a character within Sensors and line of sight: they must pass a Systems save or take 4/5/6 Energy and become infected by a catalyzing virus. While affected, they cannot clear any heat by any means (except for overheating). This effect lasts for the rest of the scene, until the Spite is destroyed, or until the affected character moves adjacent to the Spite. While at least one character is affected, the Spite is Immobilized. Targets already suffering from the virus take double damage if imprisoned again.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_imprison_spite.effect:

nrfaw-npc_npcf_swap_kit_strider.action_s: The Strider swaps to one of their available kits, gaining new attack options and a one-time bonus effect. By default they have Marksman Kit and Skirmisher Kit. Only weapons and systems from the active kit can be used each turn.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_swap_kit_strider.effect:
The Strider swaps to one of their available kits, gaining new attack options. They also gain a bonus effect that can only be used this round. By default, they have two kits, MARKSMAN KIT and SKIRMISHER KIT, and can gain more with optional systems.
In any given turn, they can only use weapons and systems from one kit. When one of the Strider’s weapons or systems are destroyed, it must be chosen from their active kit.
The Strider starts combat with any kit of their choice, but does not get the swap bonus until they swap to a different kit.

nrfaw-npc_npcf_umbral_shroud_lurker.acti: Create a Shroud Zone in a free Blast 1 area within Range 5. Maximum three active at once.
While inside a Shroud Zone, Lurkers become Invisible and gain Resistance to all damage and heat. Hostile characters inside are Shredded and Impaired.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_umbral_shroud_lurker.depl: Provides soft cover. Lurkers inside become Invisible and gain Resistance to all damage and heat. Hostile characters inside are Shredded and Impaired. Can only be targeted by tech attacks and weapons that target E-Defense; disperses on any successful attack. Maximum three active; effects do not stack when overlapping.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_umbral_shroud_lurker.effe:
At the start of any combat, when they arrive as reinforcements, or 1/round as a protocol, the Lurker can create a rippling storm of nanites – a SHROUD ZONE – in a free Blast 1 area within Range 5.
SHROUD ZONES provide soft cover. Additionally, while inside a SHROUD ZONE:
  • Lurkers (including this one) become INVISIBLE and gain RESISTANCE to all damage and heat.
  • Hostile characters are SHREDDED and IMPAIRED.

Shroud Zones can only be targeted by tech attacks and weapons that target E-DEFENSE (e.g., smart weapons). They have E-DEFENSE {10/13/16} and disperse upon any successful attack.
The Lurker can have no more than three SHROUD ZONES active at the same time. SHROUD ZONES can overlap each other, but their effects do not stack.
nrfaw-npc_npcf_umbral_shroud_lurker.name: Umbral Shroud
